provider: Gitea / Forgejo self-hosted with any S3 LFS backend

free_tier.stated: Unlimited by default: `quota.default.TOTAL = -1` means unlimited, and the soft-quota feature is 'currently not yet enabled by default'. You supply the disk/object store, so bytes = your infrastructure.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: No per-file cap unless you set one
per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Yours to pay for — unless the LFS backend is one of the free S3 endpoints (HF buckets, IA), in which case egress is the backend's and is free/CDN.

tooling: Gitea/Forgejo binaries (single Go binary), `git-lfs` client, S3-compatible LFS storage config (`[lfs] STORAGE_TYPE=minio`). REST API + Swagger for full automation. Gitea Cloud offers a 30-day trial, not free.
chaining: The pattern that makes 500 GB+ real: self-host the forge on a free-tier VM (or any always-on box) and set LFS storage to a free S3 endpoint. The forge holds ~metadata only; the bytes never touch your disk. Gitea's `LFS_MAX_FILE_SIZE`/`LFS_START_SERVER` are config, not policy.

limits.value: No per-file cap unless you set one

limits_note: Soft-quota only: 'Forgejo checks the quota usage only before an action is executed, but it will allow a started action to complete' — so it can be overshot. No per-file cap unless you set one.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Quota feature is explicitly 'still in development' with 'little support for early prevention of operations in the UI'. Self-hosted means a dead VM = dead forge, but the LFS blobs survive in the object store.
